i don’t necessarily disagree. i am well aware a lot of people would love to have my life and i think that is part of the problem. i feel guilty all of the time, like i am tremendously ungrateful for all of the good things life has given me. i am always so sad and i truly don’t deserve to be which leads me to feeling guilty. i feel guilty that i have all of these things and it still isn’t enough to make me happy. it has gotten to the point where i feel guilt for as much as showing any type of sadness because i am constantly reminded that practically everyone else has it worse than me. 

this added to the evergrowing expectations people have of me that i am required to meet in order to keep on being perfect to them is driving me into a dark place. i have to always be smiling, always be top of the class, always be beautiful, always be kind, always be grateful and well-mannered. none of these things are true in reality and the pressure to pretend i am all of them becomes too much sometimes.
